$comment: Shape only. SkillLifecycleValidation checks the rest: current equals the skills/ folders, a retired ID never returns to current, each non-null replacedBy is current, a current skill takes a reserved name only with an exception that gives the reason, each exception still matches a current reserved name, and version equals VERSION. Never name this file manifest.json: before v2.1.280, Claude Code moved the skill folders that a manifest.json in ~/.claude/skills/ listed into ~/.claude/skills/.trash/. Keep this file and its schema out of agent-harness/contracts/: private harnesses bind the source-bundle digest of that folder, and version changes at every release.

version.description: The collection release this file describes; equals the repository VERSION.

legacySources.description: Former GitHub names of this repository. An installation or lock entry that names one still belongs to this collection.

current.description: Every skill this release ships: one ID per skills/<id>/ folder, equal to its frontmatter name.

retired.description: IDs this collection shipped and no longer ships. A retired ID is never reused.

replacedBy.description: The current skill that took over, or null when the skill was removed without a successor.

since.description: The first release that ships without this ID: the upcoming release when the retirement lands, not the version that still ships it.

legacyClaudePlugins.description: The Claude Code plugin marketplace this repository published before it became a skills collection, and its plugins.

reservedNames.description: Names a collection skill must not take, because another owner exposes them to the same agents.

appleSkills.description: Skills that Xcode ships to its coding agents, across the supported Xcode releases; the set differs between releases.

appleNamespace.description: The plugin namespace under which Xcode exposes its skills as <namespace>:<skill>.

clientBuiltins.description: Skills each supported client bundles. In Claude Code a same-name skill replaces the bundled one; in Codex a duplicate name makes a plain $name mention ambiguous.

claudeCode.description: Bundled skills: the entries marked Skill in the Claude Code commands reference.

codex.description: System skills Codex embeds from codex-rs/skills/src/assets/samples.

exceptions.description: Current skills that still take a reserved name, each with the reason, until a rename retires the ID.
